title: 6.01 / Social
slide_intent: Pair channel identity with a precise destination so readers know where a social prompt leads.
strategic_value: Consistent handles and platform treatments can help Spectrum direct customers to the intended account.
demonstration: Four ruled rows pair Twitter, Facebook, YouTube and LinkedIn marks with handles or addresses.
practical_value: Check account naming and platform artwork together, treating the listed destinations as historical.

content_islands.name: Heading and usage guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the heading left, lowercase-link rule in the middle and trademark guidance upper right.

content_islands.name: Channel table
content_islands.spec: Stack four rows with cyan platform names at left, platform assets in the center and account destinations at right.

ingredient.name: Social account references
ingredient.role: Connect a platform symbol with the intended destination.
ingredient.application: Write links and handles in lowercase and follow the platform’s trademark terms.
ingredient.scope: The 2017 list; platform names, assets and destinations may have changed.
